Source: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1898748
Access: readable in browser on2026-10-06T19:10:50.939Z.

Browser bug includes failure of mutating PACKAGE_STRING defines after generation: config.h.in gets @RNP_VERSION_FULL@ from rnp_generated.py, so backend must be supplied to the generator. Configure backend option also needs the help case. Separate OpenSSL3 failure: OPENSSL_VERSION_NUMBER changed RIPEMD160 availability, but IDEA always enabled, so LEGACY is still needed for enabled IDEA/CAST5/BLOWFISH.

Exact source excerpts:
> First, changing a DEFINE value like shown above won't ever work, so the crypto backend library needs to be set another way. As PACKAGE_STRING is created when config.h.in is preprocessed by the value of @RNP_VERSION_FULL@, I modified rnp_generated.py to take the backend into account.
